verdict.rationale: Gram documents a raw execution log for every tool call across hosted, tunneled and shadow MCP servers, skills, and local tools. The log offers trace expansion and attribute filters, and an exportable audit record ties each call to a named employee, so the audit half of the story is directly covered. Nothing documents replaying what an agent did or confirms that logged payloads are complete enough to reconstruct calls. missing for 10: replay capability or documented full request/response payload capture, independent or hands-on corroboration of log depth.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did
